clue.text: Can spraying look painful on a back?

indicators.note: back tells us the whole string built from the three pieces is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: lo is an old exclamation meaning look
sore means painful

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a spray can would make a sore-looking mark on a person's back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LO + SORE + A as a single run, giving the answer; 'on' is just a joining word.
explanation.definitionFit: A spray can is a pressurised canister that dispenses its contents as a fine mist, which is exactly this device.

clue.text: See 17
Artist and children's author not finishing, caught greeting F1 driver

parts.note: Rubens was the Flemish baroque painter

indicators.note: not finishing means the author's surname loses its last letter

parts.note: J M Barrie wrote Peter Pan
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
hello is a greeting

explanation.surface: A painter and a writer of children's books, left unfinished, are caught saying hi to a racing driver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not finishing' cuts the E from BARRIE, leaving BARRI. Rubens Barrichello is a Brazilian former Formula One driver.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubens Barrichello raced in Formula One for Ferrari, Brawn and others, so he is an example of a Grand Prix racer.

clue.text: Burden having to support the swine

parts.note: to saddle someone is to burden them
to back is to support

explanation.surface: A load-bearing beast is made to carry a burden on behalf of a pig.
explanation.walkthrough: The saddleback is a British pig breed with a pale band over its shoulders.
explanation.definitionFit: A saddleback is a breed of pig, so it is one kind of swine.

clue.text: F1 driver's 'otel in southeast London?

parts.note: Lewisham is a borough in southeast London
a hotel with its H dropped, Cockney style, suggests the Hilton chain with its H dropped too

explanation.surface: A Cockney asks about the racing driver's hotel in a London borough.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H in ''otel' tells you to drop the H of HILTON as well; Lewis Hamilton is the British F1 champion.
explanation.definitionFit: Lewis Hamilton is a multiple Formula One world champion, so he is a driver in that sport.

clue.text: My name disgraced joining city in dirty game

parts.note: the idiom 'my name is mud' means I am disgraced
Bath is a city in Somerset, England

explanation.surface: A player complains that a filthy match in some city has ruined his reputation.
explanation.walkthrough: BATH is an English city famed for its rugby club.
explanation.definitionFit: A mud bath is slang for a sports match played on a sodden, filthy pitch.

clue.text: Author Thomas, queen, is overcoming male idiosyncrasy

indicators.note: in a down clue, overcoming places the earlier pieces above the letter for male

parts.note: Thomas Mann was the German novelist
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the queen

explanation.surface: A novelist, a queen and someone else are triumphing over a man in some peculiar way.
explanation.definitionFit: A mannerism is a habitual quirk of behaviour, a personal peculiarity.

clue.text: Speed with style

explanation.definitionFit: Dash means both a quick run and a stylish flair.

clue.text: Lovely Betty, an actress, removes top after a party

indicators.note: after places the trimmed surname behind the article and the party

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: removes top means the surname loses its first letter

parts.note: Betty Grable was a Hollywood star

explanation.surface: A film star takes off her hat after arriving at a party, looking charming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removes top' takes the G from GRABLE, giving RABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable means delightful and charming, much like lovely.

clue.text: See 4
Spherical, precious metal bottom

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
a bed is the bottom of a river or sea

explanation.surface: A gold ball has its base described.
explanation.definitionFit: Orbed means shaped like an orb, round or globular.

clue.text: Mind worst affected by terrible blow

indicators.note: affected means these letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's mind is badly upset by a dreadful setback.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow' looks like a setback but means a gale.
explanation.definitionFit: A windstorm is a violent blast of wind, a fierce blow in the weather sense.

clue.text: Carol thus delivered girls beach wear

parts.note: a carol is delivered by being sung
lasses are girls

explanation.surface: Carol singers hand over a girls' outfit for the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunglasses are tinted spectacles worn on the beach, so they are worn there.

clue.text: See 21
Animal having possible reason for fur coat in the country

indicators.note: in places the cause of the fur coat inside the name of the country

parts.note: China is the country
a chill is a reason to wear a fur coat

explanation.surface: An animal in some country grows a fur coat for a reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A chinchilla is a small South American rodent prized for its fur.

clue.text: See 2
Look again at king carrying English over a pit

indicators.note: in a down clue, over sets the first part above the rest
carrying means the royal title holds the letter for English

parts.note: rex is Latin for king
a mine is a pit

explanation.surface: A monarch with an English companion peers down into a mineshaft.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect something a second time is to scrutinise it once more, the plain sense of the definition.

clue.text: Long-distance traveler features with it

parts.note: a film features or stars an actor
it means fashionable, as does hip

explanation.surface: A traveller appears in a show alongside something trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' means trendy, as in 'the it girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: A starship is a spacecraft for interstellar travel, the longest distance there is.

clue.text: Plant with old saloon manufactured for F1 driver

parts.note: a fern is a plant
and means with

indicators.note: manufactured means the word saloon is built into a new order

explanation.surface: A carmaker turns out a vintage saloon fitted with greenery for a racing driver.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manufactured' makes ALONSO from SALOON. Fernando Alonso is the Spanish F1 champion.
explanation.definitionFit: Fernando Alonso is a twice world champion Formula One racer.

clue.text: Little time before two Europeans disposing of starters, one with a big appetite

indicators.note: before places the time letter ahead of the rest

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

indicators.note: disposing of starters means each of the two nationalities loses its first letter

parts.note: a Frenchman and a German give the two nationality words

explanation.surface: Shortly before two Europeans skip the first course, one of them eats heartily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposing of starters' removes F from FRENCH and G from GERMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A trencherman is a hearty eater, from the trencher or wooden plate.

clue.text: See 20
F1 driver's reported car switch

indicators.note: reported means we hear the car's name said rather than see it written

parts.note: Jensen is a British car marque, maker of the Interceptor
a button is a switch

explanation.surface: A racing driver is said to have flicked a switch in his car.
explanation.walkthrough: Jensen Button is the British 2009 F1 world champion.
explanation.definitionFit: Jensen Button won the 2009 Formula One championship with Brawn, so he is one of its racers.

clue.text: Call back, possum!

parts.note: to ring is to call on the telephone
the tail is the back end

explanation.surface: Someone tells a possum to phone them back.
explanation.definitionFit: The ringtail is a kind of Australian possum with a curling tail.

clue.text: Wash bed, you ghastly old brothel!

indicators.note: ghastly means these letters are horribly mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A disgusted visitor orders a seedy old brothel to clean its beds.
explanation.definitionFit: A bawdy house is an archaic term for a whorehouse or bordello.

clue.text: Europeans with Sudanese connections

indicators.note: with together with connections says the answer sits inside the next word
connections here means letters joined up within the word Sudanese

explanation.surface: Some Europeans have links with Sudan.
explanation.definitionFit: Danes are people from Denmark, a European nation.

clue.text: F1 features here

parts.note: F1 read as F then 1, the figure one giving ace, the one on a card or die
F1 read as F then 1, the figure one giving ace, the one on a card or die

explanation.surface: A Formula One programme lists its star attractions.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'F1' as F followed by 1, and 1 as ACE; 'features' looks like motor-racing highlights but means eyes, nose and mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: The face is where facial features such as the eyes and nose are found.

clue.text: One grand prix is suspended by one denying Christ's divinity

parts.note: hung means suspended
an Arian followed Arius, who denied Christ was fully divine

explanation.surface: A Formula One race is put on hold by a heretic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hungarian Grand Prix is a Formula One race held near Budapest.

clue.text: F1's old flower power?

parts.note: a former Formula One team that bears the name of a water flower, so its engines are a kind of flower power

explanation.definitionFit: Lotus is a former F1 team named after the water flower sacred in Asia.

clue.text: Give me a ring for a term in linguistics

parts.note: give with a ring means to phone
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a call about some technical language.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give ... a ring' means phone, with 'me' in between.
explanation.definitionFit: A phoneme is a distinct unit of sound in a language, a technical linguistic term.

clue.text: Quiet girl on river

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A shy girl sits beside a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Shannon is the longest river in Ireland.
